messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated error rate detected for model-runtime in us-east1. 5xx spike (segfaults/OOM) from inference pods. Alert group: runtime.errors.model. Rate: 11.8% over last 5m. Paging oncall @ryan_oncall.
ryan_oncall: on it. acknowledging incident and joining.
maria_sre: jumping in — what's the customer impact? any specific routes?
chen_runtime: root logs show repeated SIGSEGV in model-runner for r-gpt-13b-weights on seq_len ~2048. attaching short tail: ```
[2026-03-14T09:42:01Z] model-runner[pid=3421] segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f4c12a3 sp 0x7ffd...
Backtrace:
  0x7f4c12a3 compute_attention+0x1c3
  0x7f4c98ff execute_layer+0x4b
  0x7f4d0ef12 main_infer_loop+0x2a4
```
ryan_oncall: hmm, segfault inside attention kernel. did this start after the 09:30 deploy?
chen_runtime: yes, last model variant rollout at 09:28 — we pushed r-gpt-13b-quant v2 (kernel changes for fused-attn).
priya_prod: rolling back sounds safest. can we shift traffic to a stable variant? r-gpt-13b-quant v1 or fallback r-gpt-4b-xxs?
josh_eng: we have automatic fallback to r-gpt-4b-xxs configured in routing policy but it only triggers on capacity errors, not kernel segfaults. we can trigger a manual reroute via routing API.
maria_sre: immediate mitigation options: 1) roll model variant back to v1 2) manually reroute traffic to fallback model 3) cordon/evict affected pods to avoid repeated crashes. do we want a combo?
ryan_oncall: do 2 + 3 now: reroute traffic away from nodes running v2, and scale up alternate variant. Chen, can you list affected node IDs?
chen_runtime: affected pods: model-runner-az1-6f8, model-runner-az1-7c3, model-runner-az2-1b5. Node IDs: gpu-e-334, gpu-e-335, gpu-e-336.
chen_runtime: command I ran to get backtrace: ```kubectl logs model-runner-az1-6f8 -c runner --since=10m | tail -n 50```
priya_prod: doing manual routing change: ```curl -X POST https://routing.redwood/api/v1/overrides 
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_ADMIN' 
 -d '{"selector":"/v1/generate","from_model":"r-gpt-13b-quant:v2","to_model":"r-gpt-4b-xxs:stable","reason":"emergency segfaults v2"}'```
josh_eng: initiated. API returned 200, changing traffic weights to 100% -> r-gpt-4b-xxs.
support-bot: Notifying affected customers per playbook: creating ticket and statuspage update draft.
ryan_oncall: cordoning the three nodes now, will drain gracefully so in-flight requests finish. ```kubectl cordon gpu-e-334 && kubectl drain gpu-e-334 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=30```
chen_runtime: pods keep crashing during graceful drain, some are dying with OOM before they can flush. suggests memory regression in v2.
maria_sre: good that reroute succeeded. observing 5xx rate drop from 11.8% -> 2.3% in the last 2m, but still elevated.
ryan_oncall: temporarily increase per-request timeout and reduce batch size for r-gpt-13b-quant to reduce memory pressure on any stragglers. Josh, can you apply a runtime config change?
josh_eng: applying change: ```PATCH /runtime/configs/r-gpt-13b-quant 
{ "max_batch_size": 1, "request_timeout_ms": 60000 }```
josh_eng: applied. also disabled prefix KV cache for that variant: ```PATCH /runtime/configs/r-gpt-13b-quant {"kv_cache_enabled":false}```
chen_runtime: logs after changes show OOMs less frequent, but segfaults still happening in some workers. suspect a kernel/regression in fused-attn path.
priya_prod: customer impact summary for support: ~120 customers had degraded responses between 09:28-09:44 UTC; primary affected endpoint: POST /v1/generate, error rate peaked at 12%. Provider-tier customers with Dedicated capacity on us-east1 saw latency spikes but no data loss.
support-bot: created ticket RW-INC-2026-154 and updated status page draft: "Intermittent 5xx errors for text generation in us-east1. Mitigation in progress."
maria_sre: next steps: 1) keep traffic on fallback for 30m 2) roll back model variant in canary hosts to v1 once we confirm no further segfaults 3) incident review and RCA.
ryan_oncall: agreed. assign actions: chen to prepare core dumps and attach to the ticket, josh to coordinate rollback for v2 -> v1, priya to keep customers informed via support, maria to draft postmortem.
chen_runtime: collecting core dumps: `gcore -o /tmp/core.$PODPID $PODPID` — uploading now to RW-bucket/incidents/1902003456/cores. note: need offline analysis due to native libs.
josh_eng: starting canary rollback to v1 on 2 nodes only: ```kubectl set image deployment/model-runner r-gpt-13b-quant=registry/redwood/r-gpt-13b-quant:v1 --namespace=prod --record```
josh_eng: canary rollout in progress, watching for 5xx on canary.
maria_sre: monitoring metrics: routing override reduced global 5xx to 0.9% and us-east1 to 1.2% after reroute and drains. good.
ryan_oncall: any customer escalations?
support-bot: two customers opened support tickets, one flagged as P2, we've sent interim message acknowledging.
priya_prod: if rollout v1 is clean, we'll keep v2 disabled until kernel patch. Suggest PR to revert fused-attn change and a small integration test on long sequences.
chen_runtime: confirmed core dumps show crash inside third-party fused kernel; will open upstream bug and attach reproducer.
maria_sre: logging the incident oncall handoff for tomorrow: @ryan_oncall handing to @maria_sre at 08:00 UTC for follow-up/monitoring.
ryan_oncall: wrapping up, summary: manual routing override -> fallback model, cordoned/drained three affected nodes, applied runtime mitigations (batch size ->1, disabled KV cache), started canary rollback v2 -> v1. customer impact: elevated 5xx for ~16min for some customers, incident ticket RW-INC-2026-154 created. next: full rollback if canary OK, collect more cores, RCA.
maria_sre: thanks all. I'll run postmortem template and ping infra/research to prepare kernel revert PR and add a fuzz test for sequence lengths >1024.
priya_prod: leaving a note for product: communicate to enterprise customers on reserved capacity about failover behavior and opt-in for automatic model fallback on kernel errors.
josh_eng: I'll follow up with a hotfix branch to revert the fused-attn change and a small runtime regression test.
incident-bot: Incident RW-INC-2026-154 status: mitigated -> monitoring. SLA impact: partial; notify customers updated.
maria_sre: closing thread for live ops. file followups: postmortem, core attachments, rollback PRs. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
